design: Source-informed exploratory probe; criteria written before execution. Same assistant, not independent replication.
environment: Unmodified CommonJS helper plus a new in-memory store double. No SQLite, provider, CLI, agent process, user state, credentials, or network execution.

cases.question: Baseline unassigned open card
cases.criterion: Claim sets owner to worker-a and status running; one store write.

cases.question: Does automatic pickup exclude blocked cards?
cases.criterion: A higher-priority unassigned blocked card is chosen ahead of an open normal-priority card; state becomes running.

cases.question: Does explicit claim preserve an existing different owner?
cases.criterion: Explicit claim changes alice to bob without rejecting; existing session link remains.

cases.question: Negative control: already-done explicit claim
cases.criterion: Throws the already-done error and performs no store write.

cases.question: Reopen by board movement
cases.criterion: Moving a done card to ready sets open, preserving owner and session link.

cases.question: Scope of priority selection
cases.criterion: The store is asked for limit 100; an older critical card outside that returned window is not selected.

limits: No concurrent-writer safety, SQL persistence/foreign keys, authenticated authorization, process dispatch, integration success, or task effectiveness claim. Matching a criterion is not a product-safety PASS. A contrary result must be retained.
